Cold for 36–60 hours (even longer on Flip versions).
90% recycled stainless steel body and lid, antimicrobial drinking surfaces, elevated rubber base, 100% leak-proof with o‑ring seal.
Comparison (value focus):

Capacity & Use Case: Big Mouth is overkill (in a good way) for festivals, hikes, or group hydration; Series 3 is better if you want something lighter and more portable for routine use.
Design & Sustainability: Series 3 leans harder into sustainability with 90% recycled steel and still offers antimicrobial parts; Big Mouth leans into heavy-duty, feature-packed performance (handle, quiet base, pouring collar).
In short: Big Mouth is the best value if you want maximum capacity and extreme performance; Series 3 Bottle is the best value if you want a versatile, sustainable everyday bottle that’s easier to carry around.
